facts.fact: 开章：断头武士压顶—— recurve knife 本刺其头、只撕开枕头（羽毛飞散）；Nox 化匕首扑倒她；强制失败（神力护体），Azideh:「Not even my kind can best a god」——「Good thing I have the power of both」。
facts.anchor: Arterial blood sprayed Dante as a Solarian warrior’s headless body slumped on top of him.

facts.fact: 影杀：影比光快（shadow 是 absence）——吞掉光刃、饿影断颈；尸身右臂有熟悉符号（他认不出）；「This one stinks of Solara. Of its god.」+「Oh, yes」——还有更多。
facts.anchor: It ate the luminous ray and everything beyond it.

facts.fact: 恶魔的情报+惩罚式亲昵：拽链强吻、Dante 咬其手——讨价还价「You will get your offering...But not until I fulfill my end」——Phos 的门是临时的，快就赶得上。
门厅：Elena 战三叉戟武士、Brailee 影盾挡多尾鞭、Dante 空降一匕刺心；复活武士自爆成 solar flare——Elena 以 supernova 级 moondark 应战；武士以 Vaegan 口音反咬「Our own honored bloodline lies dead by your hand!」——Taesia（Phos 的报復）。
facts.anchor: “You dare come into my house and assault my family,”

facts.fact: 代价：Elena 碾杀武士后右臂近肩断离（Somnus 与 familiar 做止血带）；「The refugees. They need you.」——她「I'll be fine」。
facts.anchor: Their mother’s right arm was severed near the shoulder.

facts.fact: 拦路：Brailee 哭求别走——「I’ll find her, Bee. I promise. I'll bring her back」（Taesia=被撕出夜空的星座）；恶魔劝强制，Dante：「I will never do that to her. Ever.」。
facts.anchor: I’ll find her, Bee. I promise.

facts.fact: 抉择： heir 理想=舍少数救多数——「he would have to turn his back on the few to spare the many」——他跑出前门（巨眼一路追踪），把「那个恐惧的男孩」甩在影子里奔向宫殿广场。
facts.anchor: That in order to be the savior he’d dreamed of being,

facts.fact: 自责：本指望 Phos 撑到夏至——「the barriers around Vitae were thinned during the equinox; he should have planned for this」；「Where did they come from?」——「They're from the realm itself. Sent by Phos.」
